title: Build the Stalled Deal Rescue Queue Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Build the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/ai-pipeline-risk-detector.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Create the public guided demo at /blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/kit.
Kit contents: Stall Queue Setup Checklist; Stall Queue Prompt; Week-to-Week Outcome Log Prompt; Stall Limits and Skip Rules Worksheet; Outcome Log Template; Recovery Note Review Checklist; Fictional Sample Deal Export; Data and Safety Guidance.
Follow every entry in the spec's constraints list.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'Stalled Deal Rescue Queue', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows a table with exactly 4 data rows whose deal names are Northgate Clinic website rebuild, Pell & Co monthly books, Harbor Lane discovery, and Birchwood retainers. It also shows the as-of date 2026-05-11, the minimum $500, and stall limits of 14.

Step 2 shows the exact heading 'SKIP RULES FIRST'. Birchwood retainers is SKIPPED with text containing '$400' and '$500'. Pell & Co monthly books is SKIPPED with text containing '2026-05-09', 'next step', and 'not stalled'.

Step 3 lists exactly 2 queued rows, Northgate Clinic website rebuild first then Harbor Lane discovery. It shows CONFIRMED text containing 'Northgate Clinic', '8400' or '$8,400', 'proposal', '21', and '2026-04-18'. It shows the draft text 'Checking in on the $8,400 website rebuild proposal last touched April 18. Is this still useful to discuss?'. It shows CONFIRMED text containing 'Harbor Lane', '1500' or '$1,500', 'qualified', '45', and '2026-03-20'. It shows the draft text 'The Harbor Lane discovery item for $1,500 has had no recorded activity since March 20. Should we close this out or set a next step?'. It shows the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone. AI INTERPRETATION contains 'do not prove' and 'lost interest'. It shows the exact sentence 'Do not invent a contact, objection, or deadline.'.

Step 4 shows the Northgate Clinic draft. Activating 'Check numbers against the export row' reveals three rows (amount, last activity, days in stage), each containing the text 'Matches', and the values 8400 or $8,400, 2026-04-18, and 21.

Step 5 shows the fictional outcome log with Harbor Lane on_hold and Northgate still_stalled, and a mock next-week run as of 2026-05-18. The run lists Harbor Lane as skipped with text containing 'on_hold' or 'on-hold', and shows 'Logged on-hold deals are not chased again.'.

Step 6 contains the exact sentences 'You send it. Nothing is sent or written to the CRM.' and 'Do not invent a contact, objection, or deadline.' and a link to /blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every deal name, amount, stage, days-in-stage value, last activity date, next step, and status in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input rows and sample_output exactly.
Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', 'Buy Premium', '/month', or 'per month'. The only dollar figures are the fictional deal amounts and the fictional $500 minimum.
Neither page contains a percentage, a win-rate figure, an hours-saved figure, or an ROI or savings claim.
The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector'.
GET /blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/kit.

Stalled Deal Rescue Queue is registered in src/lib/blueprints.ts with id and productSlug 'ai-pipeline-risk-detector', title 'Stalled Deal Rescue Queue', access 'premium', href '/blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/kit', purchaseHref '/blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector', and badge PREMIUM. It is not added to PAID_PRODUCTS and has no Stripe price.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement(user.id, 'ai-pipeline-risk-detector') from src/lib/payments/access.ts. It exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }.

With an authenticated entitled session, the kit page renders h1 'Stalled Deal Rescue Queue Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'. Kit resource and interaction criteria below apply only to this entitled state.

With an authenticated session that has no Stalled Deal Rescue Queue entitlement, the kit page renders h1 'Premium is locked', does not render kit content sections such as #setup-checklist, and does not show a Buy Premium button or a Stripe price.

The kit page shows 8 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Stall Queue Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'SKIP RULES FIRST', 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'days_in_stage', 'last_activity', 'next_step', 'Do not invent', 'Do not send', 'Nothing is sent or written to the CRM'.
The Week-to-Week Outcome Log Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'outcome log', 'on_hold', 'lost', 'still_stalled', 'Do not send', 'Nothing is sent or written to the CRM'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Stall Limits and Skip Rules Worksheet has a visible label 'Days in stage limit' whose default value is '14', a visible label 'Days since activity limit' whose default value is '14', a visible label 'Owner minimum amount (USD)' whose default value is '500', a visible label 'Statuses that are never chased (one per line)' whose default value includes 'closed-won', 'closed-lost', and 'on-hold', a visible label 'Deals to always skip (one per line)', plus a 'Generate My Stall Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Skip closed-won, closed-lost, and on-hold.', 'Skip amounts below $500.', 'A deal is stalled when days_in_stage exceeds 14, or last_activity is older than 14 days before as_of, or next_step is blank.', 'Rank stalled deals by amount, largest first.', 'Recovery notes may use only deal name, amount, stage, and last activity date.', 'Do not invent a contact, objection, or deadline.', 'A stall flag does not prove the buyer lost interest.', and 'You send it. Nothing is sent or written to the CRM.' The block has a Copy button. The block contains no 'Always skip' line.
If the days-in-stage limit or days-since-activity limit is empty, 0, or negative, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a stall limit of 1 or more.' and generates no rules block.
If the owner-minimum field is empty, whitespace only, or negative, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a minimum amount of 0 or more.' and generates no rules block.

When 'Deals to always skip (one per line)' is empty, the generated rules block contains no 'Always skip' line. When it contains 'Harbor Lane discovery', the block contains 'Always skip: Harbor Lane discovery'.

When 'Statuses that are never chased (one per line)' contains 'closed-won', 'closed-lost', and 'on-hold' on separate lines, the generated rules block contains 'Skip closed-won; closed-lost; on-hold.' or equivalent listing of those three statuses.

The Outcome Log Template shows the columns week_of, deal, amount, action_taken, outcome, notes. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line is 'week_of,deal,amount,action_taken,outcome,notes' and whose Harbor Lane row contains '2026-05-11', 'Harbor Lane discovery', and 'on_hold'.

The Recovery Note Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.

The Fictional Sample Deal Export section is labelled 'Fictional' and its Copy CSV text equals the deal,amount,stage,days_in_stage,last_activity,next_step,status rows and header from guided_demo.sample_input.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With an authenticated entitled session, /my-blueprints shows the Stalled Deal Rescue Queue card as Unlocked with an Open Blueprint link to /blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/kit.

With an authenticated session that has no Stalled Deal Rescue Queue entitlement, /my-blueprints shows the Stalled Deal Rescue Queue card as Locked with an Available to purchase link to /blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector and no link to the kit.

With an authenticated session, /my-blueprints still shows the free Daily Inbox Starter Kit with Open Starter Kit pointing at /blueprints/daily-inbox-briefing/starter-kit. AI Collections Assistant entitlement, Buy Premium, and checkout behavior are unchanged. Security Readiness Action Pack, Google Ads Performance Coach, Quote Request Assistant, AI Expense Watchdog, No-show Recovery Assistant, Unbilled Work Review Queue, and On-brand Reply Review Queue entitlement and locked or unlocked card behavior are unchanged.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

Product implementation files live under app/blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/, components/premium/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/, and src/lib/premium/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/. The Blueprint registry entry lives in src/lib/blueprints.ts. e2e/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/authenticated.spec.ts is the protected acceptance test and must not be weakened, skipped, rewritten, or have assertions removed.

Authenticated QA uses the repository's automatic Playwright session refresh. If the session cannot be refreshed, QA stops with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED and that failure is not treated as a product defect.
The guided demo at /blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.
The kit at /blueprints/ai-pipeline-risk-detector/kit requires sign-in, is labelled Premium · Private preview, and shows no price, checkout, or purchase claim.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or sitemap.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, and its tests are unchanged.
